title: Asteroid Craft
description: Rediscover the classic: Astroid Craft transforms the overworld into an endless void filled with floating spheres. Explore structural asteroids, ore, and rare mineral cores in procedurally generated worlds for NeoForge.
body:
# AsteroidCraft

AsteroidCraft replaces the normal Minecraft Overworld with an endless void filled with floating asteroids. Instead of continuous terrain, the world is made up of countless separate spheres hanging in empty space, each one a small world of its own that you can mine, bridge to, and build on.

It recreates the feel of the classic *Planetoids* map generator by Seibei, but as a real mod instead of a pre-built map. The world is generated continuously and infinitely at runtime, so it keeps expanding with new asteroids as you explore, no size limit, and no external map tool required.

## How it plays

Every asteroid is a shell wrapped around a core, and the rarer ones hide something more valuable deeper inside. Some are plain rock and soil; others are well worth cracking open. Exploration becomes a hunt across the void for the right asteroid to mine. And since the world is empty space, reaching the next one is part of the challenge.

The void doesn't cut you off: common resources, fluids and many of Minecraft's harder-to-find materials all have their place among the asteroids, so a full playthrough is very much possible from a single floating foothold. Not everything is reachable yet (but most parts) — the mod is actively growing, and each update adds more asteroid types and brings more of the game into the void.

## The Nether and beyond

The Nether gets the same treatment: step through a portal and you arrive in a second void world of floating islands with its own asteroids, so both dimensions share the same sky and the same sense of drifting between worlds. The End remains reachable too, for those who make it that far.

## Loaders and versions

AsteroidCraft runs on NeoForge, Fabric and Forge for Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2 — just grab the file that matches your loader (the Fabric build also needs Fabric API). It is server-friendly: on a server only the server needs the mod, and players without it can still join. Since it overrides the Overworld and the Nether, start a new world for it to take effect, and avoid pairing it with other mods that change world generation in those dimensions.
